reviewUpdated: **Updated:** 17 November 2026 — Run 05 portrait tiles and bounded session-model work. Original findings and earlier snapshots remain historical; [the delivery ledger](DELIVERY_PLAN.md#complete-scope-and-resolution-ledger) owns current status.
planCurrentState: **Current state:** Run 05 completes **P05.6/.7**: the versioned portrait tile specification and shared alphabet/converter/quiz composition, pinned fonts, measured baseline correction and Android inverse-SP/cache repairs. **P05 remains active** for reopened P05.2 and partial P05.8: Android ordinary text clips during live text-size changes, iPad window controls overlap Home, one converter raster check misses tolerance by 0.012 physical px, and specific native coverage remains unrun. P07.2’s pure session model/tests are delivered; its screen/audio integration and P07.4 remain unfinished. Final shared checks pass 80 tests, types/lint, the Expo-free scan and production web gates; actual native candidates/metrics/captures are recorded. P00–P04 retain agent-done status; P06/P08–P10 and M11 remain unfinished. [Run 05 evidence](evidence/run05/README.md), [source identity](evidence/run05/source-identity.json). This is not release approval.
